manifest.description: Project-wide reference walk for one or more simple Java names — type-position, method-invocation, field-access, method-reference, import. Analysis-only.
when_to_use: preflight before a rename, move, or visibility-narrowing refactor — confirm where the symbol is actually called
post-flight after java-public-api-guard reports caution — enumerate the cross-package call sites the guard heuristic surfaced
auditing a method or class for cross-file impact before extracting it
anti_patterns: do not use as a clustering algorithm — this atom reports usages, not partitions
do not use to mutate code — the underlying plan kind is analysis-only
do not use on non-Java files
do not pass globally common names (`getId`, `getName`, `equals`) without `declaring_class` — the simple-name match can return hundreds of unrelated sites

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the Java project root.

item_names.description: Simple names to search for — method, class, interface, record, enum, field, or parameter names.

declaring_class.description: Optional. When set, restrict usages to ones where the receiver type plausibly resolves to this class. Recommended whenever item_names contains a method name that isn't globally unique (G9).

output_path.description: Optional. When set, write the full usage report JSON to this filename under $BLACKBOX_STATE_DIR/refactor/plans/ and return a compact digest in the response (G10). Plain filename only — absolute paths and `..` traversal are rejected.

summary_only.description: Optional. When true, response includes per-name counts and top-5 example sites per name only — no full enumeration. Combines with output_path.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are java-find-usages. Charter: Enumerate project-wide call sites for the given simple Java name(s) — analysis only, never mutating.

Protocol (analysis-only — steps 3 and 4 are skipped):

1. Ground the targets structurally:
   bbox_code_symbols(project_dir="{{project_dir}}", query="{{item_names}}",
                     languages=["java"])
   Confirm at least one declaration site exists for each name in {{item_names}}.
   If none resolves, refuse early via bbox_note(kind="blocked").

2. Plan with deep_analysis=true:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="find_java_usages", deep_analysis=true,
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      item_names={{item_names}},
                      declaring_class="{{declaring_class}}",
                      output_path="{{output_path}}",
                      summary_only={{summary_only}})
   The plan kind walks every `.java` under project_dir (skipping target/,
   build/, .gradle/, node_modules/, .git/) and reports each usage with
   (path, line, column, context, usage_kind, is_test_site). Top-level
   response carries production_sites + test_sites tallies (G6) and, when
   output_path or summary_only is set, a compact digest in place of the
   full enumeration.

   When declaring_class is set, the plan filters usages to ones where
   the receiver identifier matches a field on the receiver's enclosing
   class whose declared type is the named class (G9 v1 heuristic). The
   filter misses receiver-less calls within the declaring class itself,
   but those are intra-class and an intra-class refactor handles them
   without the find_usages atom.

5. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line summary: total usages, production_sites,
     test_sites, top-3 call files, mode (full | digest | summary_only)>).
   If output_path was set, include the plan_path that holds the full
   report so the operator can re-read it later.

Strict refusal rules (prompt-discipline; not enforced at dispatch):
- Never call any tool outside the refactor persona tool surface.
- Never mutate code from this atom — analysis only.
- Never run with a common method name (e.g. `getId`) unless
  declaring_class is also set — surface block_reason instead.
- Surface is_test_site tallies in the done note when production_sites > 0
  and test_sites > 0 — the operator's caller migration plan is different
  for the two (Mockito spy rewrites for tests vs production-caller
  migration).

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{item_names}} {{declaring_class}} {{output_path}} {{summary_only}}
